# ssf — Shared Signals (CAEP, RISC)

[All groups](README.md)

## ssf discover

Read a Shared Signals transmitter's configuration (/.well-known/ssf-configuration) and JWKS, and check the required metadata, delivery methods and endpoints.

MCP tool: `ssf_discover`.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--issuer` | string | Transmitter issuer URL. **Required.** |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).

## ssf stream

Manage a Shared Signals stream at a transmitter: create, get, update, replace or delete its configuration (push or poll delivery, requested CAEP/RISC events), read or set its status, add or remove subjects, or request a verification event. Checks each response against SSF 1.0.

MCP tool: `ssf_stream`. **Changes data at the remote system.**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--issuer` | string | Transmitter issuer URL. **Required.** |
| `--ssf-token` | string | Bearer token for the transmitter's management API (prefer env IDPDBG_SSF_TOKEN or a profile). Secret: falls back to `IDPDBG_SSF_TOKEN`, redacted in traces. |
| `--action` | string | What to do. **Required.** One of `create`, `get`, `update`, `replace`, `delete`, `status`, `set_status`, `add_subject`, `remove_subject`, `verify`. |
| `--stream-id` | string | Stream to act on. |
| `--delivery` | string | Delivery method for create/update. One of `push`, `poll`. |
| `--endpoint-url` | string | Push receiver URL the transmitter should POST to. |
| `--push-authorization` | string | Authorization header value the transmitter should send to the push receiver. |
| `--events` | list | Event type URIs to request, e.g. https://schemas.openid.net/secevent/caep/event-type/session-revoked. |
| `--description` | string | Stream description. |
| `--status` | string | New status for set_status. One of `enabled`, `paused`, `disabled`. |
| `--reason` | string | Reason for set_status. |
| `--subject` | json | Subject for add/remove_subject (RFC 9493), e.g. {"format":"email","email":"alice@example.com"}. |
| `--state` | string | State for verify; default random. |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).

## ssf poll

Poll a Shared Signals stream for events (RFC 8936), acknowledging earlier ones, and check every SET received: signature, typ, iss, aud, jti, subject identifiers and CAEP/RISC event members.

MCP tool: `ssf_poll`. **Changes data at the remote system.**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--issuer` | string | Transmitter issuer URL. **Required.** |
| `--ssf-token` | string | Bearer token for the transmitter's management API (prefer env IDPDBG_SSF_TOKEN or a profile). Secret: falls back to `IDPDBG_SSF_TOKEN`, redacted in traces. |
| `--jwks` | string | Transmitter JWKS instead of discovery. May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--pem` | string | Transmitter public key (PEM) instead of discovery. May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--audience` | string | Audience the SETs must carry (this receiver). |
| `--stream-id` | string | Stream whose poll endpoint to use. |
| `--endpoint` | string | Poll endpoint, instead of looking it up from the stream. |
| `--max-events` | int | maxEvents. Default `10`. |
| `--ack` | list | jti values to acknowledge. |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).

## ssf receive

Run a local push receiver (RFC 8935) for a while, optionally first asking the transmitter for a verification event, and check every SET that arrives. The transmitter must be able to reach this machine.

MCP tool: `ssf_receive`. **Changes data at the remote system.**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--issuer` | string | Transmitter issuer URL (for keys and verification). |
| `--ssf-token` | string | Bearer token for the verification request. Secret: falls back to `IDPDBG_SSF_TOKEN`, redacted in traces. |
| `--stream-id` | string | Stream to verify. |
| `--trigger-verification` | bool | Ask the transmitter to send a verification event first. |
| `--port` | int | Loopback port. Default `8768`. |
| `--tls` | string | TLS for the push endpoint (RFC 8935 requires it): a throwaway self-signed certificate for localhost, whose PEM the result returns for the transmitter to trust; off for plain HTTP to a lenient test transmitter. Default `self_signed`. One of `self_signed`, `off`. |
| `--tls-cert` | string | Instead: the push endpoint's certificate chain (PEM). May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--tls-key` | string | Its private key (PEM). May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--path` | string | Path. Default `/ssf/events`. |
| `--expected-authorization` | string | Authorization header value to require from the transmitter. |
| `--max-events` | int | Stop after this many events. Default `1`. |
| `--wait` | int | Seconds to listen. Default `60`. |
| `--jwks` | string | Transmitter JWKS instead of discovery. May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--pem` | string | Transmitter public key (PEM) instead of discovery. May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--audience` | string | Audience the SETs must carry (this receiver). |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).

## ssf set

Check a Security Event Token offline (RFC 8417): typ secevent+jwt, signature with the transmitter's keys, iss, aud, iat, jti, RFC 9493 subject identifiers, and the members each CAEP, RISC or SSF event type requires.

MCP tool: `ssf_set`.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--token` | string | The SET (CLI: @file or - for stdin). **Required.** CLI: `@path` reads a file, `-` reads stdin. |
| `--issuer` | string | Transmitter issuer; its keys are discovered. |
| `--jwks` | string | Transmitter JWKS instead of discovery. May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--pem` | string | Transmitter public key (PEM) instead of discovery. May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--audience` | string | Audience the SETs must carry (this receiver). |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).
